tool.name: ATRIUM page-classification models
tool.description: stages fine-tuned models of ufal/vit-historical-page on the server
tool.command: export MPLCONFIGDIR="\$PWD/.matplotlib" && mkdir -p work '$out_file.extra_files_path/models' && ## run.py --hf downloads one revision, its base model and its processor into the folder, and ## classifies nothing. The runs' own paradata stays in work/. cd work && #for $revision in str($revisions).split(','): python3 /app/run.py --hf -rev '$revision' --models-dir '$out_file.extra_files_path/models' && #end for cd .. && python3 '$write_entry' '$out_file' '$revisions' '$value' '$name'

configfiles.configfile:
import json import re import sys
out_file, revisions, value, name = sys.argv[1:5] revisions = [r for r in revisions.split(",") if r] ensemble = {"v1.4", "v2.4", "v3.4", "v4.4", "v5.4"} if not value.strip(): value = "vX.4-ensemble" if set(revisions) == ensemble else "-".join(revisions) value = re.sub(r"[^\w.\-]", "_", value.strip()) if not name.strip(): label = "ensemble" if set(revisions) >= ensemble else ", ".join(revisions) name = f"ufal/vit-historical-page {label}" entry = {"value": value, "name": name.strip(), "revisions": ",".join(revisions), "path": "models"} with open(out_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump({"data_tables": {"atrium_page_models": [entry]}}, handle) print(json.dumps(entry))

param.name: revisions
param.label: Revisions to stage
param.help: All five for the ensemble (about 2.5 GB); the tool's single-model mode needs only the one it runs.

param.name: value
param.label: Id of the entry
param.help: Empty: vX.4-ensemble for all five revisions, otherwise the revisions joined by '-'.

tool.help:
Downloads fine-tuned models of `ufal/vit-historical-page`_ once, with their base models and image processors, into a folder that the *ATRIUM page classification* tool reads offline (``run.py --models-dir``). Without it, every job of the tool downloads its model again.
Each entry of the ``atrium_page_models`` data table is one folder. Stage all five revisions for the ensemble; one revision is enough for the tool's single-model mode.
The tool runs in a container: the destination that runs it must mount the data manager's data path (``galaxy_data_manager_data_path``) into the container, read-only.
The models are CC BY-NC 4.0.
.. _`ufal/vit-historical-page`: https://huggingface.co/ufal/vit-historical-page
